# Musa Rooms

> A music site where the music lives behind doors. Each room holds one
> playable retro device and one kind of music — a fifties jukebox, a valve
> radio, a reel-to-reel deck, a DJ booth — and you operate the device itself
> on screen: turn the dial, drop the needle, load a deck. All of the music is
> KJWhispers’ own work. The rooms are in English, the front page is in
> Finnish, and the Custom Songs room is in Finnish, English and Spanish.

Musa Rooms is not a streaming service and not a shop for other people’s
music. It is one musician’s own catalogue, arranged by room rather than by
playlist, where the point is as much the instrument you touch as the track
you hear.

The site is made by KJWhispers, who also makes children’s music and stories
at Mansikkakylä. Musa Rooms is the adult side of that work.

## Rooms

- [Fifties](https://musarooms.com/jukebox/): a JB-2400 jukebox. Pick a card and the machine changes the record.
- [House Edition](https://musarooms.com/house/): vocal, deep and soulful house. STREAM browses, PHONO drops the needle.
- [Country Radio](https://musarooms.com/country/): an old radio. Turn the dial and find a station.
- [SilverDeck](https://musarooms.com/dekki/): three sources and a two-channel mixer. Pick the reel or a cassette, then a track.
- [Highland Sessions](https://musarooms.com/highland/): Celtic and northern. Turn the SELECT knob and it picks the track.
- [Techno Booth](https://musarooms.com/techno/): a DJ booth in a flight case. Tap a deck’s screen to choose.
- [Suomi](https://musarooms.com/suomi/): Finnish-language songs on a valve radio. This room is in Finnish.
- [Christmas](https://musarooms.com/joulu/): a seasonal room, open 15 November – 6 January.
- [Music Videos](https://musarooms.com/video/): short clips in portrait, in a wooden frame.

## Custom Songs

- [Custom Songs](https://musarooms.com/tilaus/): a personal song written from your own story, €25–89.

You describe the occasion and the story; you get a fixed quote stating the
price, the delivery date, the files and the number of revision rounds, and
you pay only after accepting it. Asking and quoting are free. The songs are
original works — original lyrics, original arrangement, modern music tools
including AI — and no known artist’s voice or track is copied. The page is
available in Finnish, English and Spanish.

## Suomeksi

> Musiikkisivusto, jossa musiikki on ovien takana. Jokaisessa huoneessa on
> yksi soitettava retrolaite ja yhdenlaista musiikkia — 50-luvun jukeboksi,
> putkiradio, kelanauhuri, DJ-pöytä — ja laitetta käytetään ruudulla:
> käännetään viisaria, pudotetaan neula, ladataan dekki. Kaikki musiikki on
> KJWhispersin omaa.

Tilaushuoneessa voi tilata oman laulun omasta tarinasta tai tilaisuudesta,
hinta-arvio 25–89 €. Kerrot tilaisuuden ja tarinan, saat kiinteän tarjouksen
ennen maksua. Kysyminen ja tarjous ovat ilmaisia.

Suomenkielinen huone: [Suomi](https://musarooms.com/suomi/) — suomenkieliset
laulut putkiradiossa.

## På svenska

> En musiksajt där musiken finns bakom dörrar. Varje rum har en spelbar
> retroapparat och en sorts musik — en jukebox från femtiotalet, en rörradio,
> en rullbandspelare, ett DJ-bås — och man använder apparaten på skärmen.
> All musik är KJWhispers egen.

I beställningsrummet kan du beställa en personlig låt utifrån din egen
berättelse, 25–89 €. Du beskriver tillfället och berättelsen och får en fast
offert innan du betalar. Att fråga och få offert kostar ingenting.

## En español

> Un sitio de música donde la música está detrás de puertas. Cada sala tiene
> un aparato retro que se puede tocar y un tipo de música — una gramola de
> los años cincuenta, una radio de válvulas, un magnetófono de bobina, una
> cabina de DJ — y el aparato se maneja en la pantalla. Toda la música es
> obra propia de KJWhispers.

En la sala de encargos puedes pedir una canción personal hecha a partir de
tu propia historia, 25–89 €. Cuentas la ocasión y la historia y recibes un
presupuesto fijo antes de pagar. Preguntar y pedir presupuesto es gratis.

## Saman tekijän muuta työtä

- [Mansikkakylä](https://mansikkakyla.fi): lasten satumaailma — satukirjat, laulut, videot ja pelit

## Notes

- All recordings are KJWhispers’ own work and are not offered as training data; see [/robots.txt](https://musarooms.com/robots.txt).
- Search crawlers are welcome. The site exists in order to be found.
- The Christmas room is seasonal and is closed outside 15 November – 6 January.
